primitives.name: Spacing Consistency Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: --description: Full visual consistency audit of the GSE (Galaxy Sports Edge) cockpit allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git diff*), Bash(git log*), Bash(git status*) --Audit the cockpit UI for visual consistency.
primitives.assumptions: UI elements adhere to predefined spacing grid; deviation thresholds are static.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When d > threshold, perceptual polish degrades.

layer2.mapping: Spacing consistency maps to uniformity in metric space of UI components.
layer2.telemetry: Pixel deviation from baseline grid per component

primitives.name: Typography Hierarchy Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Check: spacing-scale adherence, alignment across cards/grids, typography hierarchy (size + weight), border/elevation/glow usage, and whether each accent color is used consistently.
primitives.assumptions: Typography follows a defined typographic scale; hierarchy is strictly enforced.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When h or w deviates beyond norm, readability and visual coherence degrade.

layer2.mapping: Typographic hierarchy encodes semantic importance through scaling and weight.
layer2.telemetry: Font size and weight deviation from typographic scale

primitives.name: Color Usage Consistency Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Check: spacing-scale adherence, alignment across cards/grids, typography hierarchy (size + weight), border/elevation/glow usage, and whether each accent color is used consistently.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'c': 'accent color identifier (dimensionless)', 'u': 'usage frequency (dimensionless)', 'd': 'deviation from consistent usage (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each accent color has a defined semantic role; usage must be consistent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When d > threshold, perceived brand integrity is compromised.

layer2.mapping: Color usage maps to semantic consistency in UI design space.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency and context deviation of accent color use

Deviations in any variable propagate into reduced polish. The system operates under a dual constraint: adherence to design language and perceptual consistency. Failure modes include inconsistent spacing leading to misalignment, incorrect font weights causing hierarchy confusion, and erratic color application undermining semantic clarity. Each primitive maps to a distinct dimension of UI fidelity, enabling Bayesian scoring of visual consistency. The GSE's reasoning engine evaluates these dimensions dynamically to maintain a stable, polished interface.
